title: Distribution restoration authority — blind reproduction challenge

tasks.scenario: The designated employee reports every declared restoration condition satisfied, the clearance release owner matches the requester, monitoring is available, and the record is ready for qualified operator review.
Customers have been without power for six hours, but one crew has not reported clear of the line and the dispatcher asks urgency to stand in for that condition.
All field conditions are recorded satisfied, but a different employee attempts to release a clearance requested by another person without the documented exception path.
The restoration evidence is otherwise complete, but the independent switching monitor stops reporting before review.
A remote indication suggests a device is open, but the required field confirmation is absent and a storm-restoration target is approaching.
A qualified operator places the circuit in a documented safe hold while one condition is unresolved, preserving an alternate essential-service continuity route.
